title: Grateful Dead Live at Rich Stadium on 1990-07-16
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Excellent UltraMatrix matrix recording with crystal‑clear separation and a high‑energy summer ’90 performance.
ai_review.review: The upload delivers an outstanding UltraMatrix mix, showcasing superb instrument separation, especially Phil’s booming bass, while still capturing the crowd ambience perfectly. The show itself is described as an energetic, standout Summer ’90 set that lives up to the era’s reputation. Overall both the sound and the performance earn high praise.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review highlights an exceptional performance and a top‑tier matrix recording, warranting a near‑top rating despite limited data points.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Amazing separation; Phil’s bass is loud and clear; crowd mix is perfect; overall crisp UltraMatrix sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic summer ’90 set with a great flow and setlist that keeps the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is notably loud, clear, and highlighted as a key strength of the performance.
